verdict: Leads are up sharply, but none have moved into your pipeline yet.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 87 leads from Meta at a cost of $20.83 per lead — a 34% improvement in cost per lead compared to the prior 7-day period, driven by the August Re-Launch campaign finding its footing. The concern is what happens after the lead arrives: none of the 87 leads have converted into an active opportunity in your CRM, which means the intake process is not yet closing the loop. Automated follow-up via SMS and phone is being connected this week to ensure leads are contacted immediately and tracked through to a case. Once that automation is live, you should see contacts moving from lead to opportunity, giving a clearer picture of what this ad spend is actually producing in signed cases.
